name: @iron-software/design-system
description: Iron Software Design System — tokens, Tailwind theme and Astro components
//: No "type": "module" on purpose — tailwind.config.js is CommonJS and the checker loads it with require(). The checker itself is .mjs, so it is ESM regardless.
//workspaces: The playground is a real Astro app used only to RENDER components so docs demo markup can be generated instead of hand-written. npm workspaces cannot link the root package to its own workspaces, so playground depends on it as "file:.." — see playground/README.md.

scripts.check:vars: tailwindcss -i tailwind/theme.css -o node_modules/.tmp/theme.compiled.css && node scripts/check-component-vars.mjs node_modules/.tmp/theme.compiled.css
scripts.check: npm run check:theme && npm run check:utilities && npm run check:tokens && npm run check:parity && npm run check:exports && npm run check:vars && npm run check:docs-css && npm run check:contrast && npm run check:catalogue && npm run check:seo && npm run check:manifest && npm run check:fonts && npm run check:code && npm run check:render
